Exercise: Warm-up: 3 min brisk march or walk, 10 TRX squats, 10 glute bridges, 10 leg swings/side
Intensity: Easy
Notes: Get warm, not tired. Use this to check how the knees feel today before loading them.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Hold the TRX straps, sit back to the chair, stand up tall. 3 sec down. Knees can travel forward over toes, that's normal and fine. Use the straps only as much as you need. Pain rule: up to 3/10 knee discomfort during is fine if it settles by next morning. Sharper than that, shorten the range or swap to the easier option.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Whole foot on the step, push through the working leg, don't spring off the back foot. Lower down slowly over 3 sec, that lowering phase is what builds the quad.

Intensity: Controlled, good form
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Slide down the wall to a depth that feels like hard work with no sharp knee pain. Breathe. A pain free, controlled way to load the quads directly.

Exercise: TRX Chest Press (or incline push-up on bench/bench edge)
Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Body straight like a plank, lower chest to hands, press back. Walk feet back to make it harder, forward to make it easier.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Top leg slightly behind you, toes pointed forward, lift and lower slowly. Should burn on the side of the hip. Hip strength helps control where the knee goes.

Intensity: Controlled, good form
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Stand on one leg near the wall or TRX for safety. Soft knee, tall posture.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Lower back stays pressed into the floor. Slow, controlled breathing out as the arm and leg extend.

Intensity: Easy

Exercise: KB Deadlift (from block or step if needed)
Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Push hips back, flat back, KB between the feet. Stand up by driving the floor away. 3 sec lower. Build the hinge before chasing weight.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Hold the straps, long stance, drop the back knee straight down. Front knee can come forward over the toes. 3 sec down. Pain rule: up to 3/10 knee discomfort during is fine if it settles by next morning. Sharper than that, shorten the range or swap to the easier option.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. DB on the hips, squeeze the glutes at the top for 2 sec. Ribs down, don't arch the lower back.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Body straight, pull chest to hands, squeeze shoulder blades together. Walk feet forward to make it harder.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Kneel on one knee (cushion under it), squeeze the glute of the down leg, press straight up without leaning back.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. Hold both straps, hinge on one leg, back leg reaches behind you. Strength and balance in one exercise.

Intensity: Controlled, good form
Notes: Week 1 baseline: learn the move, pick a weight or support level you could do 3 more reps with. KB in one hand, walk tall without leaning. Trains core, grip and single leg control with every step.

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)

Exercise: Incline Push-Up (hands on bench or bench edge)
Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)

Intensity: RIR 3 (3 reps left in the tank)
